# Install the Supply Chain pack

Full guides for every platform are in [docs/install](../../docs/install/). Quick routes:

| Platform | Fastest route |
|---|---|
| Claude Code | `/plugin install supply-chain-skills --marketplace gifmaster/department-skills` (older versions: `/plugin marketplace add gifmaster/department-skills` then `/plugin install supply-chain-skills@department-skills`) |
| Claude (web, desktop, mobile) | Upload a zip from `dist/skills/` in the Skills section of settings ([guide](../../docs/install/claude.md)) |
| ChatGPT (Skills) | Skills → Create → Upload from your computer, choose a zip from `dist/skills/` ([guide](../../docs/install/chatgpt.md)) |
| Custom GPT or ChatGPT Project | Paste the text below the marker in `PROMPT.md` into Instructions |
| OpenAI Codex | `./install.sh codex supply-chain` |
| Gemini CLI | `gemini skills install https://github.com/gifmaster/department-skills.git --path departments/supply-chain/skills` or `./install.sh gemini supply-chain` |
| Gemini app (Gems) | Paste `PROMPT.md` into the Gem instructions; optionally attach `SKILL.md` as knowledge |
| GitHub Copilot (VS Code, CLI, cloud agent) | `./install.sh copilot supply-chain` or copy folders into `.github/skills/` in a repo |
| Microsoft 365 Copilot | Agent Builder → Configure → paste `PROMPT.md` into Instructions |

Whole pack as one zip: `dist/packs/supply-chain-skills.zip`. All skill names start with `scm-` so they never clash with other packs.

On Windows use `install.ps1` instead of `install.sh` (same arguments).
